column1: # Launch countdown. It counts up in Spanish because Lonapse reverses: onU, soD ... zeiD, then liftoff.
# The build gives Piper the countdown text with only the first letter as a capital (build_lonapse.py spoken_text).
# Two numbers are spelled for the voice: Sinko is spoken "Oknis" (Cinco gave "Ocnic", over 1 s with the end stop),
# Neuve is spoken "Evuen" (Nueve gave "Eveun", dragged). The period keeps every number short and level.
